query: We have an idea for an AI video workspace, but who it is really for, what outcome matters, and which assumptions should be tested first are unclear. Run product discovery before requirements.

Create a bounded Product Brief with target user, current journey, evidence, alternatives, non-goals, metrics, and experiment thresholds.
Turn this approved Product Brief into normative requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios.
Inspect package.json, routes, auth, database, tests, and build commands in this repository.
